title: Rationalization of the normalized smooth-purity diagrams
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, an integer $a\geq1$, and $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_{p^a}$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be smooth separated morphisms of pure relative dimensions $d,e\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Their composite $gf=g\circ f$ has pure relative dimension $d+e$ [lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence]. For $R=E,L$, use $\mathcal C_R(W)=D^b_c(W,R)$ [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Write $T_W=T_{L/E,W}$ for scalar extension [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. For $h=f,g,gf$ put $H_{h,R}=Lh_R^*(-)(d_h)[2d_h]$ and $G_{h,R}=Rh_R^!$, with $d_f=d,d_g=e,d_{gf}=d+e$. Use the rationalizations $\gamma_{h,R}:H_{h,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{h,R}$ of the simultaneous integral purity family of [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality], as in [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity]. Let $a_{h,M}:T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}H_{h,E}M\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{h,L}T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}M$ and $b_{h,M}:T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}G_{h,E}M\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{h,L}T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}M$ be the rationalized comparisons in that integral statement; $b$ is the specified adjoint transpose of the inverse compact-support coefficient comparison followed by the scalar-extended counit. Let $u^R_K:H_{gf,R}K\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{f,R}H_{g,R}K$ be the canonical pullback-composition, twist-addition and shift comparison. Set $q^R_K=\gamma_{f,R,G_{g,R}K}\circ H_{f,R}(\gamma_{g,R,K})$.

Every integral representative of an object of $\mathcal C_R(W)$, for $W=X,Y,Z$, belongs to the derived-complete uniform finite-Tor category on which the integral purity comparisons are defined. Rationalization gives exact functors and natural comparison isomorphisms on all of these rational categories. Let $c^R_K:G_{gf,R}K\xrightarrow{\sim}G_{f,R}G_{g,R}K$ be the rationalization of the actual integral exceptional composition comparison in [prop-pur-adic-reconstruction-trace-coherence], with the direction of [thm-pur-composition-coherence]. For every $K\in\mathcal C_R(Z)$,
$$c^R_K\circ\gamma_{gf,R,K}=q^R_K\circ u^R_K.$$
For $h=f,g,gf$ and every $M\in\mathcal C_E(\mathrm{target}(h))$,
$$b_{h,M}\circ T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}(\gamma_{h,E,M})=\gamma_{h,L,T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}M}\circ a_{h,M}.$$
These are equalities of natural transformations. The rationalized $a$ and $b$ obey the identity-extension, successive coefficient-extension tensor-associator and shift equations specified for their integral versions in [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality], using the scalar associators and shift comparisons of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-rational-lattice-adic-domain] to $W=X,Y,Z$ and to each finite coefficient field. It gives noetherianity, finite dimension and invertibility of $\ell$, and identifies the integral category underlying each raw rationalization with the derived-complete category. Every integral object has one finite Tor interval for all its reductions, including torsion objects. Thus the exact linear functors $H^{\rm int}_{h,R},G^{\rm int}_{h,R}$ and their natural purity and coefficient comparisons in [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality] are defined on the entire integral categories being localized. In particular $G^{\rm int}_{g,R}K_0$ is an admissible input for $\gamma^{\rm int}_{f,R}$. The dimension assertion of [lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence], applied to $f,g$, gives the relative dimension $d+e$ required for the same assertions about $gf$.

source.place: Transport along the same exact functors: check all integral input domains first

proof.text:
Identify the specified family before transporting composition. In [lem-pur-tower-trace-purity-comparison], the previously specified rational family has integral representatives equal to the trace-transpose family $\gamma^{\rm tr}$ of [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality], and $\gamma^{\rm tr}_{R,K_0}=\gamma^T_{R,K_0}$ as integral derived morphisms. Use this identification for $f,g,gf$. By [lem-pur-transport-integral-counit-realization], the actual tower map $\gamma^T$ is the coherent trace-transpose family of [lem-pur-tower-trace-purity-comparison], and its composition equations are those reconstructed simultaneously in [prop-pur-adic-reconstruction-trace-coherence], including the uniformizer levels through the cofinal comparison with the $\ell$-power tower. Thus that reconstruction applies to these very maps; it is not inferred from their having the same finite reductions. Its composition clause is the integral version of [thm-pur-composition-coherence]. With $c^{\rm int}:G^{\rm int}_{gf,R}\to G^{\rm int}_{f,R}G^{\rm int}_{g,R}$ and the canonical source comparison $u^{\rm int}$, that clause reads
$$\gamma^{\rm int}_{gf,R,K_0}=(c^{\rm int}_{K_0})^{-1}\gamma^{\rm int}_{f,R,G^{\rm int}_{g,R}K_0}H^{\rm int}_{f,R}(\gamma^{\rm int}_{g,R,K_0})u^{\rm int}_{K_0}.$$
Postcompose with $c^{\rm int}_{K_0}$ and cancel $c^{\rm int}_{K_0}(c^{\rm int}_{K_0})^{-1}$. This gives the integral composition diagram in the direction required here. Equality of arbitrary derived maps is never inferred merely from equality of their separate finite reductions.

source.place: Composition coherence: first identify the normalized family with the coherently reconstructed one

proof.text: Write $Q_{R,W}$ for raw scalar localization. By [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization], each exact integral functor and natural comparison extends, with component $Q(\eta_{K_0})$, retaining exactness, inverses, vertical composition and whiskering. [lem-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-identification] identifies the extended $H^{\rm int},G^{\rm int}$ with the specified rational pullback/twist/shift and exceptional functors, on objects, arrows and shift comparisons, and identifies the extended integral scalar functor with the $T$ used here, together with its associators. This is an identification with the actual operations, rather than a replacement of $G$ by a duality formula. The localized purity is the $\gamma$ of the statement. Naturality holds on every rational arrow: for an integral arrow $v$ it is the image of integral naturality; for $v/\varpi_R^n$ both sides are multiplied by $\varpi_R^{-n}$, and additivity handles sums, as prescribed by [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization].

source.place: Transport along the same exact functors: extend functors and transformations on all rational arrows

proof.text:
Apply $Q_{R,X}$ to the integral equality of Step 2. The $c$ in the statement is, by its specification, $Q(c^{\rm int})$. The source comparison $u$ is $Q(u^{\rm int})$: both are the pullback-composition, twist-addition and shift maps used in that integral composition clause, with the rational operations defined by extending their integral arrow actions [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Preservation of whiskering and vertical composition in [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization] gives explicitly
$$Q(c^{\rm int})Q(\gamma^{\rm int}_{gf})=Q(\gamma^{\rm int}_{f,G^{\rm int}_g(-)})H_{f,R}(Q(\gamma^{\rm int}_g))Q(u^{\rm int})=q^R u^R.$$
This is $c^R\gamma_{gf,R}=q^Ru^R$. Every rational object is an integral object in the raw localization, and all displayed maps are natural by Step 3; hence this is the asserted equality of natural transformations on the whole category.

source.place: Composition coherence transported along the same exact functors: apply localization to the integral equation

proof.text:
For each $h=f,g,gf$, localize its integral scalar square from [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality]. Under [lem-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-identification], the resulting $a$ is the specified pullback/tensor/twist/shift comparison, and the resulting $b$ is exactly the exceptional counit-preserving mate specified here. That lemma identifies $T$ with localized integral scalar extension and asserts the square on all rational morphisms. In components it is
$$b_{h,M}T_{\mathrm{source}(h)}(\gamma_{h,E,M})=\gamma_{h,L,T_{\mathrm{target}(h)}M}a_{h,M}.$$
Its identity, successive-extension and shift assertions are also supplied there. More explicitly, localize the integral equations for $a,b$: identity transformations remain identities; each product and whiskered component remains the corresponding product and whiskered component by [lem-pur-semilinear-scalar-localization]. The scalar associators and shift maps are the retained ones of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], so these are precisely the requested equations, including ramified extensions. This proves the coefficient diagram and the final coherence assertions with their specified normalizations.
